title: 魏尔斯特拉斯：不用图形怎样定义趋近

claims.statement: Weierstrass 1861 lectures employed inequality-based approach to differential calculus
claims.locator: JSTAGE 2009 abstract; Volkert 2021 section on 1861 notes

claims.statement: Cauchy and Weierstrass approaches differ, but epsilon-delta rigor had multi-person development
Weierstrass lectures and student notes document changes in uniform convergence expressions during 1861–1886
Lecture terms and notation did not evolve monotonically, cannot backdate one printed wording to 1861
epsilon-delta continuity: for each ε>0 exists δ>0 such that |x-a|<δ implies |f(x)-f(a)|<ε
f(x)=x² continuous at every a with δ=min(1,ε/(2|a|+1))
Reversing ∀ε∃δ into ∃δ∀ε changes claim, generally false for x² at 3
uniform convergence ∀ε∃N∀n≥N∀x∈E vs pointwise N may depend on x
claims.locator: Volkert history plus modern formal definition

claims.statement: x^n pointwise limit on [0,1] discontinuous at 1, convergence not uniform
x^n converges uniformly to 0 on [0,r] for 0<r<1
Uniform convergence related theorems in Weierstrass 1861-1886 notes, historic methods not one final exact modern formula
Cauchy sequence over Q may fail to converge in Q; real completeness needed for limits
Precise epsilon-delta conditions motivate construction of complete real numbers, leading to Dedekind and Cantor
claims.locator: historical multiple trajectories and editorial bridge

caveats: 魏尔斯特拉斯非独自首次发明ε–δ；概念在柯西、玻尔查诺及众人工作中演化。
1861—1886学生讲义用语不同，现代量词并非一份1861原稿的逐字录文。
x²和x^n的例子是现代可验证计算，不是假托历史原题。
等距逼近的有理数柯西列不保证在有理数域有极限。
